subject: claude for small business
body_content:
Anthropic just released a major update to its small business plugin for Claude, these are 44 skills across marketing, sales, operations, and finance.

These are ready-made instructions for tasks like managing your inbox, preparing proposals, reviewing your marketing, and pulling together financial reports.

You can find the plugin under Customize → Plugins → Discover and then type “small business.”

It's a really useful starting point for anyone who wants to use AI in their business. You get ideas for what to automate, along with a great way to get started with these workflows.

But you'll still need to make them yours.

Some of these skills work surprisingly well out of the box. But they start with general instructions, so installing the plugin won't mean your business suddenly runs itself.

Your proposal format, the emails you prioritize, the metrics you track, and your hiring criteria will all be different.

Spend some time running a skill on your own work, reviewing the output, and telling Claude what to change. You can give it an existing template, explain your rules, or use the “record a skill” feature to show it how you do the task.

Then save those changes so the skill uses them the next time.

I've been testing the plugin. These are the 10 I'd start with:

  1. SMB Onboard: Connects your tools and saves context about your business so the other skills have a more useful starting point.
  2. Inbox Manager: Prioritizes your emails and drafts replies using a voice profile based on your past responses.
  3. Report Builder: Pulls data from your connected tools into a report or dashboard around the business metrics you want to track.
  4. Month-End Prep: Helps prepare a profit-and-loss summary in a spreadsheet and a one-page PDF.
  5. Proposal Builder: Turns a sales conversation and your business context into a proposal you can tailor to your own template.
  6. Invoice Chase: Checks for overdue invoices and drafts reminder emails for customers who haven't paid.
  7. Speed to Lead: Finds new inbound inquiries and drafts responses so you can follow up faster.
  8. Hiring Screener: Reviews applications against your hiring criteria and prepares a ranked shortlist for you to assess.
  9. Marketing Monday: Builds a weekly marketing briefing covering performance, customer feedback, competitors, and priorities.
  10. Review Reputation: Brings together customer reviews and feedback, highlights recurring issues, and drafts responses.

You'll probably find many other skills in the plugin that you find more useful for your business. Start with a task you already do regularly, customize the skill, and check that the output meets your standards. Then you can even let it run on a schedule, so the workflow runs on it's own and you only need to review the outputs.

I just published a video walking through these 10 skills, how to customize them, and how to schedule them.

​Watch the full walkthrough here.​

Keep going,
Ben

P.S. If you want help applying this to your own work, we have Claude courses, a library of skills, weekly Q&As, and 1:1 technical help inside the AI Accelerator.

​
